trigger: a lockout or break-glass window authored in the wrong unit (1 s read as 1 h)
summary: the SQL rewind passed whatever window was authored; the removed 3.5 s real wait used to bound it. Also raised by compliance-officer (F1) and authdb (LOW). Fixed: the rewind UPDATE matches only a window still open and <= 3 s, mutation-checked with a 3600 s window (fails at PQntuples). Fix commit(s): d3e0fde84 (lockout) + d3e0fde84 (break-glass).
classification_rationale: the test claims to prove the window lapses; it proved only that a rewound row reads expired

trigger: `svr.Put("sink.Post(", h);` followed by `sink.Post("/real", h);` - a per-method cursor let a discarded cross-method candidate hide the real Post
summary: find_route_registrations kept one consumed marker per method, so a candidate inside a consumed literal could swallow a later registration; raised by happy-path (HP-1) and unhappy-path (UP-2). Fixed with one global cursor and a regression case. Fix commit(s): ce1ad7ace.
classification_rationale: the header claimed the former single pass's non-overlap semantics, true only per method

trigger: the 2000-unterminated-candidates case passes with the remembered-offset memo removed
summary: the case could not observe the bounded scan (also unhappy-path UP-6). Fixed: a direct first_argument case where only the remembered offset refuses a text that does close, with a control call that matches. Fix commit(s): ce1ad7ace.
classification_rationale: the comment said the memo prevents a rescan; no assertion could see it

trigger: `yuzu_server_tests "<name>"` by name: Catch2 reads the comma as OR, so seven new names matched no test
summary: seven new TEST_CASE names contained commas (feedback: Catch2 comma in a test name matches no test). Renamed without commas. Fix commit(s): ce1ad7ace.
classification_rationale: a by-name run printed 'No tests ran'

trigger: a reader re-cutting pg shards trusts the comment that M starts first
summary: the comment said pg M starts first (priorities 185 and 186 lead the queue) so it is not the last finisher; nine pg shards outrank both. Raised by build-ci, cross-platform, consistency-auditor and docs-writer. Reworded: priority only orders starts; whether M finishes last on Windows is unmeasured. Fix commit(s): 4c821ff21.
classification_rationale: the sentence contradicted the priorities in the same file

trigger: a reader treats 110 s as a CI-measured figure
summary: 'D was 110 s in CI' had no source in the repo or the measurement data; #4882 states 124-131 s on the Windows build host. Replaced with the sourced figure. Also raised by docs-writer. Fix commit(s): 4c821ff21.
classification_rationale: an unsourced number presented as measured

trigger: a reader takes an inferred or unmeasured claim as measured
summary: batch: 'box load' for shard A, 43.6 s vs 41.6 s of rbac sleeps, 98.7 vs 98.9 s total, the undefined 25% rule, 'minutes on MSVC debug' (not measured), the tar starvation cause stated as fact, the docs 'tar spin fix (#5170)', McpServer 'exactly once' vs fixtures, ageing/aging, which binary 5792/5832 came from. All reworded or hedged. Fix commit(s): 4c821ff21 (+ ce1ad7ace for the doc-count line).
classification_rationale: prose accuracy; no behaviour

trigger: a stricter standard library than libc++ (libstdc++, MSVC)
summary: std::less<> and std::move were used without <functional> / <utility>. Added the includes. Fix commit(s): ce1ad7ace.
classification_rationale: a missing standard include is not a doc absence; it is a portability hygiene finding

trigger: a reader mixing the new millisecond/elapsed seams with the older second/offset ones
summary: naming only: eight new seams share one vocabulary (ms, elapsed, no-op on unknown token); the two older seams differ. Renaming public seams widens the diff for no behaviour gain.
classification_rationale: naming consistency

trigger: a test calls lapse_elevation_for_test on a non-elevated session, or an aging seam on an unknown token / store-backed AuthManager
summary: reported by consistency-auditor (F3), unhappy-path (UP-4), architect (F2): a seam can silently no-op or corrupt the never-elevated sentinel. All five test callers elevate first; every seam has zero production callers; returning bool would be a new public surface for a test-only hook. Rejected, contract documented in each seam's comment.
classification_rationale: documented contract (cache-only, no-op on unknown) matches the code

trigger: a loaded runner reaches kMaxProbeWrites and the test passes uncontended
summary: yield() and the 50000 ceiling are unmeasured for detection power (also quality-engineer, cross-platform). A CHECK that the ceiling was not reached would turn a hang guard into a flake on exactly the loaded runners it protects. Rejected; the comment now says the Windows effect is unmeasured and the PR body will not claim #5170.
classification_rationale: the test is explicitly opportunistic with a deterministic sibling

trigger: a reader takes the b25ac4638 subject '(#4882 #2600 #5170)' as a measured fix of #5170
summary: the subject names #5170 without qualification and the tar change is unmeasured on Windows. History is not rewritten; the PR title and body name only #4882 and #2600 and say the tar spin bounds are unmeasured. Decision for the operator at the push gate.
classification_rationale: commit subject wording; no closing keyword

trigger: 58 of 234 routes rely on the >= 200 floor; presence 3 s and rbac 5 s bounds still use real time
summary: UP-3 and UP-7: pre-existing, not introduced by this range, no I1-I3 impact. Recorded, not filed.
classification_rationale: outside the range's scope

trigger: 10,000 repeated `sink.Post(R"(` candidates with no closing delimiter
summary: each raw-literal candidate rescanned the whole remaining suffix (O(n^2) on adversarial source). Fixed in 87d169fb5 (remembered offset) and kept by ce1ad7ace. Fix commit(s): 87d169fb5.
classification_rationale: the header promised linear scans

trigger: `sink.Post(R"(/outer/sink.Post("/inner", h))", h);` gave old=1 new=2
summary: a registration inside an already-consumed literal was emitted. Fixed in 87d169fb5 and completed across methods in ce1ad7ace. Fix commit(s): 87d169fb5.
classification_rationale: the former non-overlapping iterator did not emit it

trigger: a reader mistakes the dated 2026-10-11 measurement for current state
summary: a dated shard-P measurement still quotes the 7.4 s the retargeting removed. Historical dated records are not current-state claims (precedent: the 2026-08-28 C-carve note keeps its original counts).
classification_rationale: dated measurement record

trigger: a route literal with backslash-CR in a CRLF-normalised source
summary: the old regex accepted a backslash followed by CR; the new scan refuses it. Cannot occur in a route path today, fails loud through the >= 200 floor, and the old regex's behaviour on CR differs between libstdc++ and libc++, so there is no single parity target. Corpus equivalence 234 vs 234 routes, zero diff.
classification_rationale: adversarial shape only

policy_floor: a broken build or test leg on any supported platform that this change INTRODUCED or newly exposed
trigger: the dev merge 10fe4a988 brought a second route scanner into route_inventory_scan.hpp while test_body_cap_route_inventory.cpp still defined the same five helpers
summary: server tests did not compile on Windows, Linux or macOS (ambiguous RegisteredRoute/read_all_cpp_files/extract_routes/probe_path/discover_mutating_routes). Fixed by routing everything through the one linear scanner (f90ae9d37, 3cdb34fbd). Recorded by the orchestrator from the CI log; reporter is the CI run, not a reviewer.
classification_rationale: a broken build leg newly exposed by a merge is a policy floor, not a derived band

trigger: every server unit run executes the label-pin case
summary: the step-up kRequired label-pin case still ran two std::regex passes over every server source (19.7 s of shard D's 25.2 s), so issue #4882's no-whole-corpus-pattern-pass goal was only partly met and no tripwire could see it. Fixed: find_step_up_calls linear matcher (1f4bbe8fc, shortened 0b24de413), case 0.08 s, test_step_up_route_inventory.cpp joins the tripwire. Also found by the Spec reviewer (MEDIUM) and Kimi (LOW).
classification_rationale: a delivered goal that is not actually reached is I6 (base MEDIUM); the label HIGH was the reporter's native word

trigger: discover_mutating_routes bound read_all_cpp_files()'s memoised corpus by value
summary: one extra deep copy of the source corpus per process; now `const auto&`. Same defect class the const& return change was made for.

trigger: a future edit to the shared extract_routes wrapper or the reader return types
summary: no test pinned the wrapper's file/receiver-line/upper-cased-method/literal-byte contract (diagnostic-only line) or the readers' by-reference memoisation. Added engineered cases (extract_routes with Post/Put/Patch/Delete, static_assert on const& plus address identity).
classification_rationale: missing test coverage, bounded blast radius

trigger: a future edit weakening the closing `)` check, the `res` token or the backslash+CR/LF refusal in find_step_up_calls/plain_literal
summary: three single-token mutants survived the first engineered cases (also found by happy-path and unhappy-path UP-4). Added a table-driven case of seven non-conforming shapes; each mutant now turns it red. A bounded-blast-radius missing test is SHOULD, not a floor.
classification_rationale: missing coverage

trigger: a reader of the comments and docs after the scan change
summary: two new test names contained commas (unselectable by name), tripwire comment said headers though the list holds a .cpp, placement paragraph and tests/meson.build paragraph still claimed ~10 s per case, source_scan.hpp consumer list, caching paragraph claimed one call site and per-TU caches, route_registration_scan.hpp header said only the first argument literal is understood, docs/ci-architecture.md and docs/test-coverage.md carried pre-merge shard figures. All reworded.

trigger: a reader trusting the label-pin header

Also Kimi K3 and unhappy-path UP-10. A glob over *_scan.hpp plus an explicit .cpp entry is the durable shape; out of scope for this fix round.

trigger: a change to route registration grammar
summary: test_same_site_exempt_inventory.cpp still has its own registration extractor and corpus walk (no pattern pass over the corpus). Unifying it onto find_route_registrations is its own security-tripwire change with its own mutation checks; pre-existing, untouched here.

trigger: a registration or step_up_fn call written as a macro, with a custom raw delimiter, quoted in a comment, or concatenated literals
summary: UP-1/UP-2/UP-3/UP-11: the lexical scans are blind to these shapes and count comments as code; the old patterns behaved identically (0 differences over 1.2M inputs). The runtime boot seal is the backstop. Not caused by this change.

trigger: every server test run (270 sites)
summary: source_scan::line_of re-walks the file per site (0.19 s on the real tree; the old code did the same std::count). Not a regression; a per-file newline index is optional.
classification_rationale: no change in cost class

trigger: a literal containing a backslash before CR or LF
summary: the old patterns' dot was library-defined on that byte; plain_literal refuses it everywhere. libc++ old==new. Adopted a one-sentence comment in plain_literal (19bbabeb9); same adjudication as row adv-kimi-k2-cr-escape.
